summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented across rich/highlighter.py (JSONHighlighter), rich/default_styles.py (six json.* keys), rich/json.py (JSON renderable plus main-guarded CLI), rich/console.py (Console.print_json), and rich/__init__.py (package-level print_json). Docs were updated in console.rst, a new reference/json.rst was added with its toctree entry, and CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added entry. New tests are in tests/test_json.py; no existing tests were modified. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the expected ANSI string in the styled test was derived from the Style and Color code rather than observed. Nothing was committed.
